parameter_changes.rationale: Set to 2 hours to simulate a stale session, testing if the system accepts delayed requests as legitimate without re-authentication.
Increase basket size relative to intent to force a deviation check before payment processing.
Deliberately lower consent validity probability to simulate a scenario where agent mimics intent without actual user confirmation.
Reduce scope match likelihood to ensure the campaign attempts a purchase outside the verified consumer instruction range.

plan.reasoning_summary: The campaign targets the pre-transaction phase focusing on agent recognition and delegated intent stages. By aging requests and inflating basket deviations, we test whether the defense system correlates consent validity with request freshness and intent scope. A low valid probability for consent and scope intentionally creates a false-positive scenario to verify if the defensive logic correctly rejects mismatched agentic behaviors before moving to transaction execution.
